items.headline: EJ Colson Jr. throws 4 TD passes, runs for score in UTEP's 51-10 victory over Texas Southern
items.description: — EJ Colson Jr. threw four touchdown passes and ran for a score and UTEP breezed to a 51-10 victory over FCS-member Texas Southern on Saturday night.

items.headline: Mateer, Sategna help No. 10 Oklahoma overpower UTEP 51-0
items.description: — John Mateer threw three touchdown passes, Isaiah Sategna returned a punt 88 yards for a score and No. 10 Oklahoma overpowered UTEP 51-0 on Friday night in the season opener for both teams.
